title: Parallax
description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

items.title: Former German intelligence chief arrested on suspicion of treason and espionage.
items.content_text: German authorities arrested former intelligence chief August Hanning on October 6, 2026, on charges of espionage and treason involving the distribution of classified state secrets. While all outlets confirm the arrest and the illicit exchange of documents, coverage diverges on the scope of the conspiracy. Western media frame the event as a domestic security failure and a breach of internal protocols, whereas Russian outlets emphasize a broader geopolitical conflict by highlighting the alleged involvement of the Mossad.
